summary: Wrote a 6-phase plan (4.25h, 4 waves) closing the three fresh-machine gaps. Resolved both open design questions explicitly: Gap 2 as option (b) keep-it-manual, decided on the vendor's own TTY-confirmation gate in sapience_adddir.py rather than the dispatch's ledger-cost framing; Gap 3 by authoring a NEW narrowed linger-state-probe activation notice in the live module, since the notice the dispatch said to keep exists only in the out-of-scope packages/sapience-flake fork. Every carried figure was re-checked against live state and the results tabled in the plan. The sudo-denied verifications are sited in a terminal operator-checkpoint phase with an exact command sequence and a pre-declared COMPLETED WITH EXCLUSIONS closure rule.

artifacts.summary: 6-phase, 4.25-hour plan closing the tokenFile, sourceDirs and lingering gaps, with both open design questions resolved and the sudo-gated verifications sited as an operator checkpoint.

user_decision.question: Acceptance Criteria 4 and the live halves of 2 and 5 need two actions no agent can take here: pasting the real Sapience token into secrets/secrets.yaml via sops, and running sudo nixos-rebuild switch (sudo is structurally denied in this harness). How should the implementation close?
options: Run the Phase 6 operator sequence yourself when the implementation reaches it, so all six acceptance criteria get live evidence
Let the implementation close with Phase 6 marked COMPLETED WITH EXCLUSIONS, recording AC4 and the live halves of AC2/AC5 as reasoned exclusions
user_decision.recommended: Run the Phase 6 operator sequence yourself when the implementation reaches it, so all six acceptance criteria get live evidence
user_decision.obligation: Acceptance Criterion 4's loginctl show-user benjamin --property=Linger reporting Linger=yes after a system switch, plus AC2's prompt-free sapience-bootstrap against a real /run/secrets/sapience_token and AC5's no-op second nixos-rebuild switch.
